title: phlomoides franchetiana
intro: Phlomoides franchetiana, commonly known as Franchet's lavender, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. It is a perennial herb with various health benefits, including its ability to calm anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Phlomoides franchetiana include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to have potential anti-cancer and anti-inflammatory effects.
